newsitem.title: DENMARK: Moeller to share in Oman oil concession.
newsitem.headline: Moeller to share in Oman oil concession.

text.p: Danish shipping and energy group A.P. Moeller said on Monday its Maersk Oil & Gas unit would acquire 25 percent of an existing U.S. Phillips Petroleum onshore oil concession in Oman.
"We have gone into a concession in Oman," Moeller chief executive Jess Soederberg told Reuters.
He said that the deal with Phillips, which covered an 18,500 square metre area in the southwest of the Gulf sultanate, was awaiting the formal approval of the Omani authorities.
Phillips gained the concession last June and has said that it plans to invest $37 million in the area over a nine-year period.
Maersk oil and gas production in the Gulf state of Qatar rose 70 percent in 1996 to 1.7 million tonnes. --Stig Pedersen, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969659
